svg.title: Very old fox face
svg.desc: A close-up of the cartoon fox as a very old grandparent: faded gray-tan fur with lots of silver, droopy ears, a few wispy hairs on top, forehead wrinkles, huge bushy white eyebrows drooping over peacefully closed eyes, half-moon spectacles low on its muzzle, long gray whiskers, a gentle smile and a fluffy white beard over its faded teal scarf.
